source: author answers of 21/11 to the three questions opened in the second pass of 20/11 and to the two points the writing side had set itself, sent with the code team's reply PHAN_HOI_YEU_CAU_20-11_BAN2_2026-11-21.docx (sha256 dbd2db4f451395ad58ab57671be24c9b6efae69efb4b0c85a167d7974ae464e2)

decisions.52: RATIFIED (a) [Q-41]: per-task training is primary; one model per task and fold, each scored on its own task; the verdict rows of E1-B are computed on the clusters of the two tasks together (48 on the registered grid) and the 24-cluster rows of each task are reported beside them; E1-A is the replication and the 96-cluster test follows section 10.8; the task-pooled run of Appendix E.4 is a labelled sensitivity analysis
decisions.53: RATIFIED (a) [Q-42]: matched slice; B2, B3, the thresholds of B4 and the neighbours of B5 are estimated on the training rows of the subgroup of the situation they score; the inner selection minimises the mean regret of the (ALL, ALL) groups of the inner validation part; the all-rows variant is a labelled sensitivity analysis
decisions.54: RATIFIED (b) [Q-43]: one family; Holm over every test row of mm_hypotheses, so that each added row changes the adjusted p of the primary rows; the writing side had recommended (a)

confirmations.facts_contract_conventions: agreed by the author: s_leak of a subgroup row is inherited from the ALL cell, as for STRICT / OVERLAP; an empty or one-class slice keeps a row with NULL metrics and its group leaves the training set (INFEASIBLE), a small slice with at least two classes stays with small_subgroup_flag; the ALL rows keep their order in the facts table (POST_MATERIALIZE_CHECKS[46]['conventions'])
confirmations.reading_of_decisions_48_and_51: agreed by the author: C2 is the registered comparison without a superiority claim; its result is written on the full-design run of check 47; no outcome of H1 is stated in the manuscript before that run; if the run supports H1 the writing side reports it and the author revisits decision 48

implementation.decision_52: metamodel 0.3.0, e1_scope = PER_TASK: E1-A, E1-B and E3 are built once per task (section 10.10 registers the main grid as task (2) x fold (2) and E3 as 3 tiers x 2 tasks); E2 is cross-task by definition; evaluation units: one task, or the two tasks together (every situation scored by the model of its own task); rows of mm_hypotheses: PRIMARY (E1-B, two tasks), PER_TASK (E1-B, one task), REPLICATION_E1A (E1-A, two tasks), POOLED_2FOLD (E1-A and E1-B, two tasks), TRANSFER_E2 (H5)
implementation.decision_53: baseline_scope = MATCHED_SLICE: on the main report slice the baselines are computed from the (ALL, ALL) training rows, so they equal those of the ALL-only analysis (tested); the learners are fitted on the rows of the five subgroups with subgroup_axis and subgroup_value as context features (FS0); hyper-parameters and the k of B5 are selected on the (ALL, ALL) groups of the inner validation part
implementation.decision_54: Holm at alpha_stat = 0.05 over every row of mm_hypotheses that carries a bootstrap p, except the rows marked DESCRIPTIVE (author decision of 13/11); the flag `supported` stays the confidence-interval criterion of Table 50 and the adjusted p is reported beside it; count of the design, not a result: on the registered grid the family holds at most 32 tests (five units, namely PRIMARY, PER_TASK CQ, PER_TASK LO, REPLICATION_E1A and POOLED_2FOLD, times the six hypotheses with a bootstrap p, H1-H4, H6 and H8, plus the two directions of H5) against 8 in the analysis executed so far; the bootstrap p has a step of 0.001 (B = 2,000, two-sided)

readings_recorded_by_the_writing_side.secondary_slices: Table 42 registers the four SEEN / UNSEEN slices as secondary report slices and Table 50 defines H1-H8 on the primary protocol: metamodel 0.3.0 writes the secondary-slice comparisons to mm_metrics_secondary as descriptions (summary, intervals, paired difference to B3) and does not put them into mm_hypotheses, so they are outside the Holm family; this reading is submitted to the author as decision 55 (Q-44); the per-group outcomes are kept in mm_recommendations_secondary, so the other reading can be computed from the same runs
readings_recorded_by_the_writing_side.verdict_rows: the verdict of a hypothesis is read on the PRIMARY rows; PER_TASK, REPLICATION_E1A and POOLED_2FOLD rows are reported beside them and change the adjusted p of the primary rows (decision 54 (b))
readings_recorded_by_the_writing_side.small_slices: rows flagged small_subgroup_flag stay in the fits (convention agreed by the author); `--small-subgroups drop-from-training` is a labelled sensitivity run (V4 of check 47)

state_of_knowledge_at_the_decision.known_to_the_writing_side_and_reported_t: the task-pooled three-seed results (H1 not supported on E1-B: +0.0029 [0.0006; 0.0057]) and the post-hoc split of the pooled model by task computed by the writing side (E1-B CQ +0.0006, LO +0.0052; 03_claims section D.5)
state_of_knowledge_at_the_decision.exploratory_per_task_run: the code team's reply of 21/11 declares an exploratory per-task run of 20/11 and states that its regret and hypothesis results are not in the reply; the writing side has not opened them; whether the author had seen those tables before answering Q-41 to Q-43 is asked for the record (decision 56, Q-45)
